claim_summaries.claim: Compact truncated-exponential log-concave measures have uniformly bounded Poincare coefficient and covariance while an explicit normalized exponential test forces the LSI parameter squared to grow linearly with cutoff.

A rare-event heteroscedastic Gaussian channel has prior-average squared Hellinger O(p) but mutual information tending to binary entropy h2(p), so no uniform affinity-to-KL conversion follows without additional likelihood control.
ArXiv:2610.05474v1 claims full KLS; if correct, it rules out the hypothetical P0=1, sigma^2->0 sequence used in the plateau corollary.
